summary: The proposed patch reverts the hash calculation to use only the creation counter, addressing the immutability issue but potentially reintroducing previous behavior.

issues.description: Reverting the hash calculation may reintroduce the issue where fields with the same creation counter but different models could have the same hash, leading to incorrect behavior in dictionaries.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify that the hash remains consistent across different models and scenarios, which is crucial given the history of related issues.
